intent: Hold the iteration-8 geometry unchanged: five sensors at y = 0.07 m, x = -0.024 to +0.024 m, 12 mm footprint, 0.12 m track, 0.03 m wheels, 0.16 by 0.14 m body and 0.6 kg mass, so the Integrator's controller change is the only variable. The trigger conditions for wheel_track are met (max_error near 0.063 m, progress near 0.3, line losses near 1 per run), so I am planning that test for the next geometry step, when the controller baseline is clean.
